geometry.action: C5 rotates the real(w3,w4) plane; K conjugates allw_i
geometry.freeness_argument: K-fixed real positive quadric has no nonzero point. If g^a K fixed a point for a!=0, its squareg^(2a) would fix it, forcing it intoQ, whereg acts trivially andK is free.
geometry.underlying_space_pi1: C2, by quotienting the acting group by itsC5 isotropy
geometry.spin_input: K preserves J^2/2+ReOmega4 and projects the standardSU4 singlet pair to one, as verified in the companionKleinSpin7 producer.

gauge_locus.covering: S3 -> RP3 -> Qprime; full deck groupC4
gauge_locus.reason: The free lift has order4, with its square the original antipodalC2. This distinguishesC4 fromC2xC2.
gauge_locus.ambient_inclusion: The gauge-locusC4 maps to ambientC2 by reduction mod2; a brane-localized order4 holonomy need not extend to bulk.

gauge.monodromy_scope: The cycle action is inner, so the gauge algebra can be described as anSU5 bundle after inner untwisting. This does not automatically choose a flat connection or breakSU5.
gauge.cohomology_reason: Over characteristic zero, averaging over the finiteC4 deck group is exact and S3 has onlyH0,H3. The adjoint invariant space has dimension12. This is local-system cohomology, not the full flux-coupled physical multiplet spectrum.
gauge.vacuum_selection: All flat choices, including trivial holonomy with unbrokenSU5, haveF=0 and zero classical Yang-Mills energy. No dynamical selection of the SM sectors is proved.
gauge.global_group_scope: Uses the simply connectedSU5 lift. Global electric charge form and full orbifold C-field gluing remain uncomputed.

spectrum.deck_character_rule: On each nonzero|m| pair: characters i^ell and-i^ell; the m0 line has i^ell. Left degeneracyell+1.
spectrum.analytic_tail_bound: lambda >=(4/9)ell^2+(4/3)ell, increasing; ell>=3 is above both displayed nontrivial minima.
spectrum.vector_scope: The two-derivative localized gauge action, using internal scalar harmonics for external vector components. Not the full fermion/scalar/brane coupled spectrum.
spectrum.tree_unification: g3=g2=g5, gY^2=(3/5)g5^2; sin^2thetaW=3/8 at the unmatchedcompactification scale, standardSU5 normalization.
spectrum.limitation: Order5, fluxN and flat holonomy are choices. Broken gauge masses remain at the AdS scale; no parametric scale separation or observed coupling/cosmology follows.

extra_gauge_and_obstruction.actual_claim: The12-dimensional result is a localized SM subsector, not the full gauge algebra. Four additional geometric vector candidates survive the simple quotient.
extra_gauge_and_obstruction.obstruction: Addingu^5+v^5 is a tempting way to remove the normal uv phase isometry while preservingC5. In the stated family the u,v Reeb charge is4/(p/2+2)<1. A holomorphic harmonic would have lambda=q(q+6)<7, violating Lichnerowicz for Ric=6g.
extra_gauge_and_obstruction.scope: This rules out that specific SE deformation family. It is not a no-go for all nonhomogeneous cones, flux deformations or gauge completions.

limits: No chiral families, anomaly completion, full localized supersymmetric action, flux/Page/gluing completion, vacuum selection or observedTOE derived. The proposed gauge geometry is a candidate.
